annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously states that when the TargetName field of a ServiceMode SVCB RR is the single dot character, the record’s owner name must be used as the effective TargetName. There is no alternative reasonable interpretation or missing constraint that would lead to materially different implementation behaviour.
